documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported record Q1 FY27 financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, and EBITDA margins over 21% driven by operational efficiencies, cost discipline, and higher value-added product sales. Management highlighted progress on capacity expansions across tire crushing, MRP, tire pyrolysis oil, and rCB, alongside international footprint expansion in Chile, Oman, South Africa, and Saudi Arabia. The company reiterated its Vision 2029 objectives of reaching INR1,000 crores in revenue, while guiding for FY27 revenue between INR670 crores and INR700 crores and blended EBITDA margins of 18% to 20%. Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported record quarterly profitability for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenues reaching Rs. 156 Cr and EBITDA exceeding Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects the PCMB division to contribute 10% of FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: With enhanced manufacturing capabilities and strong business momentum, this division is expected to contribute 10% of FY '27 revenue.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting growth of over 30% in the PP Build Tech business and aiming to cross the milestone of INR100 crores in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting growth of over 30% in this business and cross the milestone of INR100 crores in revenue in FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting revenue between INR670 crores and INR700 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Yes. So I think we have reiterated the guidelines for this current financial year is somewhere around INR670 crores to INR700-odd crores on the top line side, though we wish to maintain the kind of margin profile, what we have achieved in the Q1, but to stabilize somewhere 18 plus to 20 in between as we feel is achievable.

guidance.claim: The company targets overall EBITDA margins between 18% and 20% for the business.
guidance.quote: So when you blend that with the efficiencies, overall margins of 18% to 20% is what we believe can be delivered in a business like ours, and that is what has played out well in Q1.

guidance.claim: Pyrolysis TPO and rCB businesses are expected to contribute approximately 7% to 10% of total revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: Approximately about 7% to 10% of total revenue will come from the pyrolysis TPO RCB business.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The Polymer Composite & Masterbatch business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: This business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue to grow by 20% to 25% in FY27 from the previous year.
guidance.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

guidance.claim: The contribution from the PCMB business is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

guidance.claim: Under its Vision 2029 objectives, the company aims to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasive business is expected to deliver 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: with the steel abrasive business expected to deliver 30% volume growth in the FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial segment revenue achieved strong 58% Y-o-Y growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The Industrial segment achieved a strong 58% Y-o-Y growth in revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Export volumes delivered robust 46% Y-o-Y growth supported by a healthy order pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports volume delivered robust 46% Y-o-Y growth despite global economic headwinds, supported by a healthy order pipeline.

demand_outlook.claim: The infrastructure segment delivered 7% revenue growth in Q1 FY27 supported by increased bituminous road surfacing activity.
demand_outlook.quote: The Infrastructure segment delivered 7% revenue growth in Q1 FY27, supported by increased bituminous road surfacing activity.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment was impacted in quarter 1 due to a sharp increase in raw material prices following the West Asia conflict.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment was impacted in quarter 1 due to a sharp increase in raw material prices following the West Asia conflict, along with import/export disruption affecting the availability of key imported raw material to the turfing industry.

demand_outlook.claim: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire turfing volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire fishing volumes, while operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising raw material costs and an increasing focus on ESG goals continue to drive demand in the industrial segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising raw material costs and increasing focus on ESG goals within the tire manufacturing industry continue to drive demand in the Industrial segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment continued to offer strong growth potential with India emerging as one of the fastest-growing markets globally.
demand_outlook.quote: The segment continued to offer strong growth potential with India emerging as one of the fastest-growing markets globally.

demand_outlook.claim: The infrastructure segment witnessed moderation during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, the Industrial and Consumer segment recorded revenue growth, Steel segment remained stable while the infrastructure segment witnessed moderation.

demand_outlook.claim: Higher prices of virgin polymers drive higher motivation for blending rubber in bitumen and using recycled rubber materials.
demand_outlook.quote: That is driven by, due to these crisis, the benefit that we have seen is there is higher motivation for blending of rubber in bitumen as well as for use of recycled rubber materials in new products. It is driven by high prices of the virgin polymers.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports volume delivered robust 30% year-on-year growth despite global economic headwinds.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports volume delivered robust 30% Y-o-Y growth despite global economic headwinds supported by a healthy order pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: During Q1 of FY27, the company executed INR27 crores of capex as part of a broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q1 of FY27, we have executed INR27 crores of capex as part of our broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and '28, strengthening our growth and operational capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27, increasing the company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 tons per annum, which it is our belief is the largest capacity of MRP in the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY27 and commercial sales are expected in Q2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Rooftop solar plants were commissioned at Gummidipoondi and Varle in June 2026 and July 2026 respectively.
capex_expansion.quote: We have successfully commissioned rooftop solar plants at our Gummidipoondi, Tamil Nadu facility of 999 kilowatt power in June '26 and at our Varle, Maharashtra facility of 2,218 kilowatt power in July 2026, further strengthening our renewable energy footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 capex in Mbodla Investment South Africa has been completed, operations have commenced, and exports have begun.
capex_expansion.quote: Mbodla Investment Pty Limited South Africa continues to progress as planned. Phase 1 capex has been completed. Operations have commenced and exports of semi-process material has already begun.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur, Haryana, has been commissioned in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur (Sonipat), Haryana, has been commissioned in Q1FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term growth strategy, we incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

capex_expansion.claim: The Varale plant has reached a capacity utilization of 80%.
capex_expansion.quote: The Varale plant, the newest of our plants, has now reached capacity utilization of 80%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity of the polymer compounding facility in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been acquired from the government of Saudi Arabia to set up a 24,000 tons per annum tire recycling facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In Saudi Arabia, we have already got the land from the government of Saudi Arabia to set up a 24,000 tons per annum tire recycling facility.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved record financial performance with EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both standalone and consolidated basis.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, we achieved record financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both stand-alone and consolidated basis.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic third-party green energy sourcing initiatives resulted in savings of INR1.19 crores during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: renewable energy contributing 51% of the company's total power production in Q1 '27, supported by a more than threefold increase in renewable capacity from 1.23 megawatt to 4.48 megawatt and a strategic third-party green energy sourcing initiatives, which have resulted in savings of INR1.19 crores during the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: On a standalone basis, quarter revenue increased by 18% and EBITDA and PAT margins expanded by 638 bps and 471 bps on a Y-o-Y basis.
margins_costs.quote: On a stand-alone basis, quarter revenue increased by 18% and EBITDA and PAT margin expanded by 638 bps and 471 bps on Y-o-Y basis, which is a further validation of our robust performance.

margins_costs.claim: Renewable energy contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Renewable energy (Solar Power) has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.
margins_costs.quote: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. (South Africa) and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. (Saudi Arabia) reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.

margins_costs.claim: The company delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: despite geopolitical uncertainties and a dynamic operating environment, we achieved record tire processing volumes and delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17%.

margins_costs.claim: On a standalone basis, EBITDA and PAT margins expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps respectively to 17.2% and 10%.
margins_costs.quote: On a standalone basis, revenue remained largely stable at INR533 crores, while EBITDA and PAT margin expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps, respectively to 17.2% and 10%, reflecting our strong operational performance and sustained efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, the EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%.
margins_costs.quote: On a console basis, EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%, while revenue and PAT grew marginally by 8% and 9%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

orders_capacity.claim: The initial 6,000-ton-per-annum capacity of the PCMB division is operating at 82% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The division's initial 6,000-ton-per-annum capacity operates -- is operating at 82% utilization, while the commissioning of the expanded facility in Haryana has increased our total capacity to 18,000 tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire fishing operations capacity utilization was at 88% in India and 78% in Oman in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire fishing operations remained resilient in Q1 FY27 with capacity utilization at a healthy 88% in India and 78% in Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The company also secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Tinna expanded its tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to strengthen our processing capabilities during FY26 and expanded our tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization remained strong at 90% for India operations and 85% for Oman.
orders_capacity.quote: Tinna achieved all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization remaining strong at 90% for India operation and 85% for Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum due to an increase in capacity and utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: The Oman plant operated at 85% capacity utilization in FY26, generating revenue of approximately INR30 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The Oman plant operated at 85% capacity utilization in FY26, generating a revenue of approximately INR30 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31st March 2026 was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31st March 2026 was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's blended working capital days is 50 days.
capital_allocation.quote: We have -- our blended working capital days is 50, and that is fairly consistent actually for our business over the last 2 to 3 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders, I am pleased to inform the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP, attracting participation from leading institutional investors like ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, JM Financial Mutual Fund and Bank of India Mutual Fund.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt declined 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Balance sheet strength improved in FY26 with debt declining 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operating activities grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The company generated healthy cash flow from operating activities, which grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Profitability in Oman had been impacted in recent quarters by elevated raw material costs and the ongoing Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: While profitability had been impacted in the recent quarters by elevated raw material costs and the ongoing Middle East crisis, the implementation of corrective measures, including raw material import into Oman has led to a meaningful recovery in margins and overall profitability during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire fishing volumes, while operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices, creating a stronger demand for our bitumen as a cost-effective alternative for road infrastructure projects.

risks_headwinds.claim: Import-export disruptions caused delays in the availability of imported raw materials to the turfing industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: o Import-export disruptions caused delays in the availability of imported raw materials to the turfing industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility, and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export disruptions in Oman arose from geopolitical tensions in the Middle East during the last quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Commencement of capital works for the Saudi Arabia plant was delayed due to Middle East tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to the Middle East tensions, we thought it prudent to delay the commencement of the capital works and we are closely monitoring the situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Roadworks and modifier demand may suffer in Q1 and Q2 due to reduced availability of bitumen.
risks_headwinds.quote: And that is probably, it will be because of less availability of bitumen. Because of that, roadworks, I think, are generally suffering. As a result, the demand for our modifier may also suffer in Q1, Q2.

management_commitments.claim: The company allocated INR5 crores towards research and development in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We had mentioned in the past, and we are renewing our commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27, increasing the company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 tons per annum, which it is our belief is the largest capacity of MRP in the world.

management_commitments.claim: The rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales by Q4 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY '27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales by Q4 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Mbodla Investment South Africa expects to break even by Q2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to breakeven by Q2 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29 while maintaining certain CAGRs.
management_commitments.quote: we are targeting presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29, while maintaining 25% plus revenue CAGR, 33% plus profitability CAGR and EBITDA margins over 18% and ROCE exceeding 30%.

management_commitments.claim: Recovered Carbon Black production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Recovered Carbon Black (rCB) production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Management has earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

management_commitments.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

management_commitments.claim: The contribution from the PCMB business is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

management_commitments.claim: The capacity of the polymer compounding facility in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18% under Vision 2029.
management_commitments.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
